thread:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Paging @Ethan — SLO alert: canary-v12 rollout is causing p99 spike for /v1/generate in us-west-2 (current p99 ~ 1.8s, baseline 0.45s). Streaming stalls observed on ~3% of requests. Automatically created incident: INC-2026-1123.

Ethan (oncall): on it. grabbing current canary traffic snapshot and logs. can someone share the deploy id?

DeployBot: Deploy v12 canary started by @Jordan at 2026-03-15T09:34Z. Tag: model/redwood-v12-enc-quant. Traffic fraction: 10%.

Jordan (Eng-runtime): thanks. I rolled the canary. i’m seeing encoder tail latency creep in the perf dashboard (encoder p99 up x4). suspect quant path mismatch for long sequences.

Alyssa (SRE): confirming, traces show long encode step for requests with prompt_length > 800 tokens. KV cache hit rate unchanged. p95 jump is smaller, but p99 and streaming stalls are the real signal.

Devon (Infra): cluster metrics — GPU-side utilization normal, but one pool (canary-pool-3) shows increased IPC stalls and higher memcpy times. Could be a kernel selection mismatch on that node type.

Maria (ProdOps): customer impact check: small traffic group flagged (beta customers). No paid customers were routed yet, but we need to halt canary and reroute to v11. Can we do a quick rollback?

Jordan (Eng-runtime): recommend immediate traffic shift back to v11 for canary fraction, keep instances up for postmortem. I'll prepare a rollback plan.

Ethan (oncall): execute safety-first rollback. @Devon, can you remove canary routing? @DeployBot, start the rollback.

DeployBot: Received rollback command from @Ethan. Initiating traffic shift. Target: v11 stable. Estimated completion 2m. Progress: 0%...25%...60%...100%.

IncidentBot: Update: traffic shifted. Canary fraction now 0%. Current p99 back to ~0.48s. Streaming stalls reduced to baseline.

Alyssa (SRE): verified p99 back at baseline on slice for us-west-2. Collecting traces for the problematic requests and saving to /opt/sre/incidents/INC-2026-1123/traces.tar.gz.

Jordan (Eng-runtime): I pulled a few representative traces. root cause hypothesis: encoder quantization kernels select fallback path for sequence lengths > 512 on Ampere kernels, triggering an expensive memcpy+reformat that only manifests under the v12 weight layout. Will reproduce locally.

Devon (Infra): I also saw one node in canary-pool-3 with an old driver (430.x) — rest are 450.x. Could be the kernel/driver combo causing the memcpy regression. Logging host: canary-pool-3-004.

Maria (ProdOps): customer comms: no customer-facing impact for now, but we'll prep a short note for beta users who were routed. @Alyssa, please keep me posted if this reappears after next attempt.

Ethan (oncall): good containment. I’m going to close the live paging escalation but keep the incident open for root cause and rollback plan. Switching to follow-up channel #incidents-postmortem.

Jordan (Eng-runtime): immediate action items: (1) reproduce on canary-pool-3 driver/host combo, (2) add guard in runtime to avoid expensive fallback for long sequences (temporary max_seq cap for v12), (3) add automation to detect driver-version mismatches for canary nodes.

Alyssa (SRE): I’ll export the alert rule eval window and annotate the incident timeline. Also adding temporary near-term mitigation: autoscale extra homogeneous canary nodes with matching drivers and drain mismatched ones.

Devon (Infra): I’ll schedule a rolling update of canary-pool-3 and add host version checks in the deploy gating.

Maria (ProdOps): assigning owner for customer follow-up: Jordan and Maria. We’ll draft a short note and send to the beta cohort we touched.

Jordan (Eng-runtime): noted. I'll also prepare a minimal repro and share timeline for canary re-run (T+48h) after driver reconciliations and runtime guard in place.

Ethan (oncall): summary for pager: incident mitigated by rollback at +9m, p99 returned to baseline, no paid customer impact, root cause suspected: driver+weight-layout interaction causing encoder memcpy fallback for long sequences. follow-ups assigned. closing live-page.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-1123 transitioned to "investigating -> mitigated". Pager closed by @Ethan.

Alyssa (SRE): adding logs snippet for RCA reference:

```
trace_id: 0x7f8b2a
step: encoder_reformat
duration_ms: 1234
device: canary-pool-3-004
driver: 430.12
kernel: quant_reformat_v2
note: fallback memcpy path taken
```

Jordan (Eng-runtime): leaving this thread with TODOs in the postmortem doc. Will attach test artifacts. thanks everyone for quick coordination :thumbsup:

Maria (ProdOps): filing customer note draft. will loop in comms as soon as we have repro + action ETA.

Ethan (oncall): if anything regresses, re-open the page. otherwise I'll hand off to oncall rotation: @Alyssa for next 24h watch.

Alyssa (SRE): ack, monitoring lookback for 24h and will escalate if p99 delta > 0.2s.

DeployBot: Rollback audit: user=@Ethan, reason="canary p99 spike / streaming stalls", completed_at=2026-03-15T09:43Z.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-1123 notes saved. Follow-up channel: #incidents-postmortem.

(End of thread)
